verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs describe per-minute billing and a Usage page for viewing monthly usage, but nothing documents auto-shutdown timers, idle detection, or spend limits. Viewing usage is only an adjacent capability. A community report says support stated Lambda does not distinguish idle from in-use instances, and a user's suggestion to auto-stop by default went unanswered. This supports the absence of the capability rather than a dispute.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill
